text: {"bull":[{"point":"Revenue growth is accelerating, with a 3-year CAGR of 27% compared to a 5-year CAGR of 22%.","cite":{"table":"Revenue grew 27% a year over 3 years vs 22% over 5"}},{"point":"MSME and mid-market loan growth remains robust, reaching 23.5% year-on-year as of September 2026.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","table":null}},{"point":"Asset quality remains pristine with Gross NPAs at 1.11% and credit costs at 44 basis points in Q2 FY27.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","table":null}},{"point":"Retail disbursements showed strong momentum, increasing from ₹76,000 crores in Q1 to over ₹90,000 crores in Q2 FY27.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","table":null}}],"bear":[{"point":"Profit growth is lagging revenue, with a 20% CAGR versus 27% revenue growth over the last three years.","cite":{"table":"Profit compounded at 20% vs revenue at 27%"}},{"point":"Financing profit margins remain negative, reported at -5.8% in September 2026 and -16.9% in June 2026.","cite":{"table":"Sep 2026 reported"}},{"point":"CASA ratio has dropped post-merger; management is targeting a recovery to pre-merger levels of 38% to 40%.","cite":{"quarter":"Q1 FY27","table":null}},{"point":"Analysts questioned low Liquidity Coverage Ratio and whether branch productivity can sustain liability accretion in changing markets.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","table":null}}],"watch":["Achievement of the 85% to 90% Loan-to-Deposit Ratio target by FY27.","Margin reversal and neutral-to-positive trajectory as the interest rate cycle shifts.","Employee cost impact from the new labor code versus industry peers."]}
